As for the appearance, the packaging is what you'd expect from Elemis—clean, luxurious, and minimalistic. It feels high-end without being over-the-top. The texture of the serum itself is lightweight and silky. It absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky or greasy residue, which I appreciate, especially during the day under makeup. One thing I truly enjoy is how it seems to restore and balance my skin. My T-zone feels less oily, and the dry parts of my face are more moisturized. If you're looking for something to bring life back into your skin, especially if you're dealing with early signs of aging or dullness, this serum is absolut
